stated: Properly fund the impartial BBC World Service from the Foreign Office budget and restore its global reach.

source.quote: Properly fund the impartial BBC World Service from the Foreign Office budget and restore its global reach.

bearing_set.reason: The BBC World Service is a front-line soft-power and counter-disinformation asset; its funding level and global reach directly affect the UK's resilience to external information threats and national security posture.

Committing Foreign Office budget to 'properly fund' and restore the World Service is a real spending pledge; its fiscal scale affects the funded/borrowed balance and must be scored against O12's debt-path sustainability indicator, even if the absolute sum is modest.

membership_note: Bearing-set is O5 (soft power / national security) and O12 (fiscal cost of spending pledge). No direct domestic effect on living standards, prices, labour, healthcare or inequality reaches non-negligible thresholds; the soft-power-to-trade (O13) link is real but too attenuated to clear the bar independently.
